# Moneyhelper

> A local-first AI finance application for individuals and small companies covering bookkeeping, reconciliation, portfolio risk, statements and tax, with all numbers computed by deterministic code.

Requires Python 3.10+ and Node 20.19+; data is stored in a local SQLite file with no account or telemetry. The model only phrases precomputed values with provenance records, and live trading is never automatic — the default broker is NullBroker in dry-run. Deeper documentation includes architecture.md and module-map.md.

## Docs

- [Moneyhelper](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/README.md): Bookkeeping, ledger, procurement, reconciliation, portfolio risk and tax, where all numbers come from deterministic code.
- [Moneyhelper · 能自主干活的 AI 财务部门](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/index.md): Overview of the AI finance department: one-sentence bookkeeping, risk control, tax estimation, with quickstart and MCP integration links.
- [快速开始（15 分钟）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/quickstart.md): Steps to start backend and frontend, record a first entry, and set up the test baseline in 15 minutes.
- [对话工作流指南（对话即中枢）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/WORKFLOW.md): Chat as the central hub: bookkeeping, quotes, positions, morning report, memory, follow-up handling, and safety boundaries.
- [命令行（CLI）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/cli.md): CLI commands, global parameters, exit codes, and remote/local modes, calling moneyhelper.core directly without HTTP.
- [连接中心（Connect Hub）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/connect-hub.md): External platform connections via direct sync, pairing codes, or manual import, with security boundaries, API, tools and configuration.
- [连接中心 · 深化篇（v4.5）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/connect-hub-deep.md): Tencent quote source with field parsing, market breadth temperature, stock profiles, pretrade checks, broker holdings, invoices, tax, cashflow.
- [边界攻坚（v4.6）：能抄的都抄了，不能抄的说清为什么](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/hardening.md): Hardening v4.6: invoice QR-first recognition with OCR fallback, PDF statements parsing and reconciliation, rule-based transaction categorization.
- [Agent Studio（角色 / 技能 / 提示词 / 约束 / Hook / 市场）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/studio.md): Editing roles, skills, prompts, constraints, hooks and marketplace assets, with four ways to add items and permission modes.
- [把 Moneyhelper 接进你的 AI（MCP）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/mcp-guide.md): Connecting Moneyhelper's MCP server to Claude Code, Cursor and Cline, configuring tokens, available tools, and write approval thresholds.
- [可复核性标准草案（M6.6）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/reviewability-standard.md): Reviewability standard: five hard requirements covering deterministic numbers, null handling, traceable methodologies, audit chains and data provenance.
- [自托管](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/self-host.md): Self-hosting data location with WAL, encrypted backups, reverse proxy setup and deployment forms sharing the same core.
- [部署配置指南](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/DEPLOY.md): Local run requirements, one-click startup scripts, Docker deployment, security configuration for external access, and data backup paths.
- [配置说明（环境变量 + 应用设置项）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/CONFIG.md): Environment variables in backend/.env, runtime app settings, AI endpoint requirements, settings validation, multi-tenancy, and MCP plugins.
- [Moneyhelper 架构图](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/architecture.md): Mermaid diagrams of the overall system architecture, financial department mode, question-answering execution path, and data reliability.
- [Moneyhelper — 系统架构文档](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE-detail.md): System architecture covering LangGraph multi-agent orchestration, tech stack layers, data flows, design decisions, and feature coverage.
- [Moneyhelper v2.0 · Agent 技术栈全景图（2022-2026 盘点）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE-v2.md): Survey of 2022-2026 agent ecosystem choices: orchestration, MCP protocol upgrades, long-term memory, and Moneyhelper integration plans.

- [开发指南（培训用）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/DEVELOPMENT.md): Developer onboarding: running the project, architecture and Q&A data flow, adding tools, tests, and releases.
- [Moneyhelper — 代码规范与工程约定](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/CODE_STYLE.md): Coding standards and engineering conventions: Python and TypeScript style, security practices, testing, and protocol compliance.

- [Moneyhelper（Moneyhelper）内部严格技术评审报告](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/REVIEW-%E5%86%85%E9%83%A8%E4%B8%A5%E6%A0%BC%E8%AF%84%E5%AE%A1.md): Historical internal technical review snapshot: architecture strengths, write-tool isolation, multi-agent orchestration, and security findings later fixed in 2.6–2.9.x.
- [Moneyhelper 前端代码审计报告](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/AUDIT-frontend.md): Historical frontend audit snapshot covering XSS, token storage, SSE cleanup, memory leaks, virtualization, i18n consistency, and component structure findings.
- [Moneyhelper(moneyhelper) 深度代码审计报告 · 企业级视角](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/AUDIT-enterprise-deep-20261007.md): Historical enterprise-perspective deep audit: vault PBKDF2 concurrency flaws, DEK tombstone risks, overall risk rating, and P0 remediation proposals.
- [依赖替换清单（少写代码，多用成熟库）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/DEPENDENCY-REPLACEMENT.md): Dependency replacement checklist: already replaced items with regressions, P1/P2 candidates, explicitly rejected replacements, replacement pacing rules, and known gaps.
- [Moneyhelper 企业化改造方案](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/ENTERPRISE-ROADMAP.md): Enterprise transformation plan: current product state, target three-layer architecture, fixed security issues, and phased roadmap.
- [现有账本的 tenant_id 映射与双写评估（切片 7c）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/LEDGER-TENANT-STRATEGY.md): Evaluation of tenant_id mapping for existing ledgers, arguing against dual-write and for a permissions-first order.
- [自检记录（2026-11-11）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badhope/moneyhelper/main/docs/SELF-CHECK.md): Self-check of a demo instance after security fixes: run setup, screenshots, page findings, and issues fixed or deferred.
